intuition.title: Uniform solution-processable particles
intuition.text: The source links uniform nanocrystals and stable dispersions to smooth, densely packed assemblies formed by spin casting.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Introduction; Main PDF p. 3, Morphology discussion

intuition.title: Oxygen vacancies, activated Sn and ligand removal
intuition.text: The authors attribute the reducing-atmosphere improvement to increased oxygen vacancies and electrically activated Sn4+ doping. Longer annealing also reduces organic barriers. These are source interpretations, not direct quantitative measurements of vacancy populations or activated dopant counts.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3, Annealing atmosphere/time discussion; Main PDF p. 4, IR and transport discussion

intuition.title: Transport/transparency compromise
intuition.text: Higher-temperature treatment improves mobility but can promote aggregation/shrinkage and reduce transparency. The chosen 300 °C treatment balances these measured properties.

intuition.title: Precursor selection
intuition.text: The authors select In(acac)3 and Sn(acac)2Cl2 because of similar decomposition temperatures, which they argue facilitate Sn doping. Other metal acetates and chlorides were tested without success, but exact identities, amounts and outcomes are absent; no fully specified failed recipes are invented.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
